project.name: fitbase
project.description: FitBase is an exercise library, workout builder, and training log — a buildless single-page app deployed on webface.cloud (fitbase.webface.cloud) with a PocketBase backend, seeded with a 1,324-exercise MIT-licensed dataset.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-facing build guide for the FitBase frontend, spelling out webface.cloud platform rules (no server code, same-origin PocketBase SDK, escape user content) and PocketBase JS SDK patterns for reads, auth, realtime, and file URLs.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Claude-specific project instructions (identical to AGENTS.md) defining the webface.cloud hard rules and PocketBase SDK usage patterns that govern how the FitBase buildless frontend must be developed.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview for FitBase describing the exercise dataset and Gym visual media licensing, the three PocketBase collections (exercises, workouts, sessions) with their fields and access rules, and the buildless static stack.

nodes.name: app.css
nodes.summary: Complete dark-theme stylesheet for the FitBase SPA, defining CSS custom properties and layout for the top bar, exercise library grid, exercise modal, auth card, workout builder, session runner, history, toasts, and mobile responsive rules.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS custom properties for a dark palette and pins form-control font-size to 16px to prevent iOS Safari from zooming the viewport on input focus.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Single-page HTML shell for FitBase, carrying OG/Twitter social meta and an analytics tracker script, and wiring the hash-routed nav (Library, Workouts, History), view container, and script tags for the vendored PocketBase SDK, app.css, and app.js.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads the vendored pocketbase.umd.js before app.js and includes a deferred external analytics tracker (insights.webfacemedia.com) keyed to data-site=fitbase.

nodes.name: app.js
nodes.summary: The entire FitBase SPA: a buildless, hash-routed client that renders the exercise library, workout builder, live training session, and history views, talking to a same-origin PocketBase backend. Includes email/password auth plus forgot-password and in-app reset-confirm flows.
nodes.languageNotes: Vanilla-JS single-page app with no build step; routes are dispatched from a `routes` map keyed by URL hash, and handler functions are attached to the global scope for inline onclick handlers. All DB-sourced strings are passed through an `esc()` HTML-escaper before templating.

nodes.name: DESIGN.md
nodes.summary: Design note (2026-07-19) capturing FitBase's scope, key product/architecture decisions, and the PocketBase collection layout backing the app.

nodes.name: pocketbase.umd.js
nodes.summary: Vendored, minified PocketBase JavaScript SDK (UMD build) providing the PocketBase client, auth store, cookie/token helpers, and collection API used by app.js.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-line minified UMD bundle; not authored in this project and intentionally not deep-analyzed.

nodes.name: setup_fitbase.py
nodes.summary: One-off provisioning script that authenticates as a PocketBase superuser, creates the exercises/workouts/sessions collections with their API rules, and batch-imports the exercise dataset.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses only the Python standard library (urllib-style REST calls) to talk to the PocketBase admin API; run once out-of-band, not part of the deployed frontend.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Hash-router dispatcher: parses the URL hash, updates nav active state, refreshes the auth box, and invokes the matching view renderer from the routes map.

nodes.name: renderAuth
nodes.summary: Renders the sign-in / sign-up form view and wires its submit handler.

nodes.name: renderForgot
nodes.summary: Renders the forgot-password request view where the user enters their email to receive a reset link.

nodes.name: doForgot
nodes.summary: Submits the forgot-password form by calling PocketBase requestPasswordReset for the entered email and reporting status.

nodes.name: renderResetConfirm
nodes.summary: Renders the in-app reset-confirm view for a reset token, letting the user set a new password.

nodes.name: doReset
nodes.summary: Submits the reset-confirm form via PocketBase confirmPasswordReset, validating the new password and redirecting to sign-in on success.

nodes.name: doAuth
nodes.summary: Handles the auth form submit: creates a new user (sign-up mode) then authenticates with email/password against the PocketBase users collection.

nodes.name: renderLibrary
nodes.summary: Renders the exercise library view: loads the catalog, builds equipment/target/category filter controls, and wires filter events that repaint the exercise grid.

nodes.name: paintGrid
nodes.summary: Renders the filtered, paginated grid of exercise cards with lazy-loaded images pointing at the media CDN.

nodes.name: openDetail
nodes.summary: Fetches a single exercise and opens a modal showing its media, muscles, instructions, and a language selector for localized step text.

nodes.name: renderWorkouts
nodes.summary: Renders the workouts list view (auth-gated), delegating to the editor for a specific id, and offering create/start/delete actions per workout.

nodes.name: renderWorkoutEditor
nodes.summary: Renders the editor for a single workout: its ordered exercise items with sets/reps inputs and reorder/remove controls.

nodes.name: pickWorkout
nodes.summary: Opens a modal to add an exercise to an existing workout or to a newly named one.

nodes.name: addToWorkout
nodes.summary: Appends an exercise (deduped) to a workout's items and persists the updated item list to PocketBase.

nodes.name: startSession
nodes.summary: Initializes an in-memory training session from a workout, seeding per-exercise set entries, then navigates to the session view.

nodes.name: renderSession
nodes.summary: Renders the live training session UI: per-exercise set rows with reps/weight inputs plus add/remove-set controls and a form-check link.

nodes.name: finishSession
nodes.summary: Filters out empty sets and persists the completed session (entries + notes) to the PocketBase sessions collection.

nodes.name: renderHistory
nodes.summary: Renders the training-history view (auth-gated), listing past sessions with computed set counts and volume totals and expandable per-exercise detail.

nodes.name: req
nodes.summary: Thin HTTP helper that issues an authenticated JSON request to the PocketBase REST API and returns the decoded response.

nodes.name: ensure_collection
nodes.summary: Idempotently creates a PocketBase collection from a schema payload, tolerating the already-exists case.

layers.name: App Shell & Markup
layers.description: The single-page HTML shell that wires nav, social meta, and script tags, plus the dark-theme stylesheet that lays out the library, workout builder, session runner, and history views.

layers.name: SPA Logic
layers.description: The buildless hash-routed client (app.js) that renders every view and talks to the same-origin PocketBase backend, together with the vendored PocketBase JS SDK it depends on.

layers.name: Backend Setup & Data
layers.description: The one-off provisioning script that creates the exercises/workouts/sessions PocketBase collections with their API rules and seeds the exercise dataset.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Project overview, design notes, and agent-facing build guides covering the webface.cloud platform rules, PocketBase data model, and SDK conventions.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to learn what FitBase is: a buildless single-page app on webface.cloud offering an exercise library, workout builder, and training log, backed by a same-origin PocketBase instance. The README also documents the three core collections (exercises, workouts, sessions) with their fields and the exercise dataset/media licensing, giving you the data model before you meet the code. Keep this collection layout in mind — every view you'll tour reads and writes to exactly these three tables.

tour.title: The App Shell
tour.description: index.html is the entire HTML surface: it carries the OG/Twitter social meta and analytics tracker, defines the hash-routed nav (Library, Workouts, History) plus a single view container, and loads the PocketBase SDK, app.js, and app.css. app.css is the dark-theme stylesheet that lays out the top bar, exercise grid, modal, auth card, workout builder, session runner, and history — the only styling in the project. Because there is no build step, these two static files are shipped as-is to the browser.
tour.languageLesson: A buildless SPA relies on the browser natively parsing ES modules and plain CSS — no bundler, transpiler, or framework runtime. The single #view container plus a hash router is the whole app skeleton.

tour.title: The SPA Core & Router
tour.description: app.js is the heart of FitBase and, by fan-in, the most depended-upon file in the project — the shell loads it and every doc points back to it. It is a single buildless module whose route() function reads window.location.hash and swaps the active view into the #view container. All data access flows through the vendored PocketBase SDK (pocketbase.umd.js), which app.js instantiates against the same origin to get the client, auth store, and collection API. Understanding route() is the map for everything that follows: each hash maps to one render function.
tour.languageLesson: Hash routing (#/library) lets a static SPA do client-side navigation with zero server config — the browser never issues a new request, so the same index.html serves every route.

tour.title: Authentication & Password Reset
tour.description: Before any collection is readable, the user must authenticate. renderAuth draws the login/signup card and doAuth calls the PocketBase auth store to establish a session. The forgot-password path is fully in-app: doForgot requests a reset email via the SDK, while renderResetConfirm shows the token-entry form and doReset submits the new password back to PocketBase. This is the one flow that spans multiple views yet lives entirely in the client, relying on PocketBase's built-in auth endpoints rather than any server code.

tour.title: The Exercise Library
tour.description: With a session established, renderLibrary is the default landing view. It fetches the exercises collection and hands the records to paintGrid, which renders the card grid you saw styled in app.css. Clicking a card triggers openDetail, opening the exercise modal with the full description and media. This read-only browsing view is the simplest example of the app's pattern: fetch a collection, paint the DOM, wire click handlers.

tour.title: Workout Builder, Sessions & History
tour.description: This is FitBase's core loop. renderWorkouts lists saved workouts and renderWorkoutEditor lets the user assemble one from library exercises (via addToWorkout). startSession turns a workout into a live training run, and finishSession writes the completed set/rep data into the sessions collection. renderHistory then reads those sessions back to show past training. Together these views connect all three PocketBase collections — exercises feed workouts, workouts drive sessions, sessions become history.

tour.title: Backend Setup & Data Seeding
tour.description: Everything the client reads assumes the PocketBase backend already exists — that provisioning happens here. setup_fitbase.py is a one-off script that authenticates as a superuser and uses ensure_collection (built on the low-level req helper) to create the exercises, workouts, and sessions collections with their API access rules, then batch-imports the exercise dataset. The companion DESIGN.md captures the scope and architecture decisions behind this layout. Run once, this script is what makes the same-origin data model from Step 1 real.
tour.languageLesson: PocketBase collection API rules are declarative filter expressions stored on each collection — the setup script provisions them once so the buildless client needs no server-side authorization code of its own.
